```yaml
name: Auto Merge Release

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 4 * * *' # Runs daily at 4am UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  auto-merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Authenticate with GitHub
        run: echo "${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}" | gh auth login --with-token -

      - name: Check for open release->main PR
        id: check-pr
        run: |
          PR=$(gh pr list --state open --base main --head release --json number -q .number)
          echo "::set-output name=pr::$PR"

      - name: Merge PR if exists
        if: steps.check-pr.outputs.pr != ''
        run: |
          gh pr merge ${{ steps.check-pr.outputs.pr }} --merge --auto || exit 0

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "mise-en-dev"
          git config user.email "devops@mise.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Auto merge release into main" || true

      - name: Push changes
        run: git push origin main
```
